title: Your Spreadsheet Is Not a Full-Time Job
description: A tiny automation idea for moving repeatable data into a spreadsheet — without the usual copy-paste marathon.
hook: Somehow, copying data into spreadsheets is still a job description.

scenes.headline: STILL COPYING DATA?
scenes.narration: Somehow, copying data into spreadsheets is still a job description.
scenes.caption: A very exciting career path.

scenes.headline: THE MANUAL METHOD
scenes.narration: Open a file. Find a number. Copy it. Paste it. Repeat. Truly, the future we were promised.
scenes.caption: Click. Copy. Paste. Regret.

scenes.headline: THE BETTER METHOD
scenes.narration: For repeatable digital documents, a small script can extract the fields you need and write them to a sheet. Real files vary, so check the results.
scenes.caption: Extract. Validate. Export.

scenes.headline: LESS CLICKING. MORE LIVING.
scenes.narration: Same boring data. Fewer boring clicks. A modest victory for civilization.
scenes.caption: A modest victory for civilization.
